summary: End-to-end validation of the NEW features: Brokers CRUD, ranking enrichment (photo + comissao_corretor), commission split on sales (broker_split 60/40), Import CSV with Brazilian formats (R$ and DD/MM/YYYY), and the Loteamento rename on both backend and frontend. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests pass (15 regression from iteration_1 + 8 new in test_new_features.py). Frontend (injected session cookie): header 'Corretores' button opens brokers dialog; 'Novo corretor' form saves with war_name/full_name/phone/CRECI/email → card appears with stats; delete removes it. Nova venda shows 'Loteamento' label (no 'Imóvel'), Quadra/Lote, Cliente nome/número/e-mail; typing valor+% auto-fills comissão total; broker_split=60 → Corretor R$ 3.000 / Imob R$ 2.000; switching to 70 → R$ 3.500 / R$ 1.500 live; submitting creates the sale and the list shows the Loteamento column. Import dialog opens with recognized columns and 'Baixar modelo CSV' link. Ranking renders trophy for #1 (AN avatar) and medals for #2/#3; broker photos set via /api/brokers propagate into /api/ranking responses.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py build_sale_from_row hard-codes 60/40 split on import; expose it as query/header parameter for flexibility (or persist a per-user default on the users doc).
GET /api/brokers returns a plain list; consider wrapping in {items:[...]} for pagination later. Also sorts in Python after fetch — fine at <500 docs, add index on user_id for scale.

_broker_comm falls back to 60% when both broker_commission and agency_commission are 0, but if a legitimate sale genuinely has zero commission it will still compute 0 — ok, just note the branch condition `(bc or ac)` means 'at least one is non-zero'; may be clearer as explicit `if bc is not None and ac is not None`.
parse_brl / parse_date return 0.0 / today on failure silently; import endpoint should collect per-row errors and surface them (e.g., {imported:N, errors:[{row,msg}]}) so users can fix invalid rows.

Base64 photo stored directly in the broker document can bloat the ranking response (photos replayed per request). Consider a dedicated GET /api/brokers/{id}/photo endpoint, or a thumbnail field + 304-cached photo endpoint, if users upload many brokers.
BrokersDialog file size is manageable but inline BrokerForm + list could be split into two files for readability.

SaleFormDialog mixes derived commission_value into form state via side-effect useEffect; this is fine but makes the field editable AND auto-overwritten on each keystroke of rate/value — users editing comissão total get overwritten unexpectedly. Consider marking the input readOnly, or only auto-fill when the field is empty.
